programme.title: Altas capacidades
programme.desc: Alicia y Gonzalo creen haber encontrado la oportunidad perfecta para su hijo Fer: una plaza en un colegio laico de élite. Pero ese salto de clase pondrá a prueba sus valores, su pareja y todo lo que decían hacer solo por el bien del niño.

programme.title: Instrucciones para cocinar un pollo bajo tierra
programme.desc: El verano ha terminado. Una pareja está en un rodaje en Menorca. Hay un Decathlon de fondo. Todo parece que podría desmoronarse en cualquier momento. La directora, que también es la actriz principal, busca una epifanía.

programme.title: El fantasma de mi mujer
programme.desc: Fernando ve cómo su vida salta por los aires cuando su amante le llama en plena crisis: dice haber atropellado a su esposa. Lo que parecía una infidelidad más se convierte, entonces, en un enredo criminal de consecuencias imprevisibles.

programme.title: Cuerpos locos
programme.desc: Una niña de diez años, Ana, y su futura madrastra, Sara, que está a punto de casarse con su padre, intercambian sus cuerpos por una extraña magia que se produce durante un insólito fenómeno meteorológico.

programme.title: La cena
programme.desc: Tras el final de la Guerra Civil, a Franco se le antoja celebrar la victoria en el Hotel Palace, ahora un hospital. Un teniente, un maître y un grupo de prisioneros republicanos, deben preparar un banquete exprés... pero, en la cocina, se trama algo más.

programme.title: Con quién viajas
programme.desc: Cuatro desconocidos quedan en el centro de Madrid para ir en coche a Cieza, Murcia, gracias a una aplicación de viajes compartidos. Durante el trayecto los pasajeros charlan sobre aspectos de su vida para romper el hielo. Todo fluye con normalidad, pero el conductor parece ocultar algo y se comporta de forma extraña.Con cuatro únicos (y excepcionales) actores, esta divertidamente surrealista 'road movie' entre Madrid y Cieza supone el debut en la dirección de largometrajes de Martín Cuervo (nominado a los premios Goya con su corto ''Final''), quien también escribe esta comedia llena de incógnitas y giros inesperados que no pierde el ritmo en ningún instante a pesar de desarrollarse en un único escenario y con tan sólo cuatro actores.

programme.title: 8 citas
programme.desc: Ocho parejas viven sus respectivos romances, cada una a su manera y cada una en una etapa diferente. La primera cita, la sexualidad o la convivencia son algunos de los conflictos que se les plantean.Peris Romano (''Ell@s'') y Rodrigo Sorogoyen (''Impares'') escribieron y dirigieron juntos esta comedia coral que, además, suponía para ambos el debut en la dirección de un largometraje (Romano había escrito y dirigido el corto ''El efecto Rubik'' y Sorogoyen tan solo había trabajado en televisión). Gracias a ella, obtuvieron el premio a la mejor ópera prima en el festival de Peñíscola.Sin duda el mayor gancho de la película es su reparto que, siendo una historia coral, reúne a algunas de las estrellas del cine y la televisión españolas con más tirón comercial del momento. Entre ellos destacan la ganadora del Goya por ''Mar adentro'', Belén Rueda; el popular Fernando Tejero (''Aquí no hay quien viva''); Raúl Arévalo (premiado dos veces por la Unión de Actores Españoles por ''Siete mesas de billar francés'' y ''Azuloscurocasinegro''), o Ana Wagener, (ganadora también del premio de la Unión de Actores por ''El patio de mi cárcel''), por mencionar solo algunos.

programme.title: La cólera del viento
programme.desc: Valencia, finales del siglo XIX. Un pistolero taciturno llega a una aldea en la que un cacique y aristócrata abusa de los trabajadores en su comunidad.Western rodado por Mario Camus (''Los Santos inocentes'') al principio de su carrera y en el que todo está organizado para el lucimiento de su protagonista, Terence Hill. El actor, cuyo verdadero nombre es Mario Girotti, estuvo secundado por Teresa Gimpera y Fernando Rey.Fuertemente influenciado por el Spaguetti Western, el filme de Camus se pierde en introspecciones meditabundas que malogran el ritmo de la película y dejan sentir en el espectador las casi dos horas de duración, que transcurren sin demasiada acción.

programme.title: Salario para matar
programme.desc: Billy es un mercenario de origen polaco que se contrata al mejor postor. Llegado a México durante la revolución de Villa, traba amistad con Paco, un bandido sin escrúpulos que tiene ciertos ribetes de patriota. ''Spaghetti western'' a cargo de Sergio Corbucci, uno de los directores más representativos del género. Al frente del reparto internacional, Franco Nero, Tony Musante y Jack Palance.

programme.title: Con el viento solano
programme.desc: La vida de Sebastián, un gitano de 28 años, cambia radicalmente cuando mata a un hombre. A partir de ese momento empieza una huída en la que debe enfrentarse tanto con sus perseguidores como con sus sentimientos de soledad y culpa. Drama dirigido por Mario Camus y basado en la homónima novela de Ignacio Aldecoa, publicada en 1956 dentro de la trilogía ''La España inmóvil''. La película es un relato seco y conciso del tormento psicológico por el que atraviesa un hombre en conflicto consigo mismo, papel que interpreta el bailarín Antonio Gades. Imperio Argentina interpreta un pequeño papel como madre del protagonista.

programme.title: Miss Carbón
programme.desc: Carla comienza a trabajar en la mina cuando su nombre oficial todavía era Carlos, pero tras ser aprobada la Ley sobre la identidad de género, cambió su DNI, se operó y, como mujer, logró ingresar en la mina rompiendo el sistema desde dentro.

programme.title: El talento
programme.desc: A unos días de presentarse a la prueba que le permitirá cumplir su sueño de estudiar en Viena, la joven violonchelista Elsa descubre, durante la exclusiva fiesta de su amiga Idoia, que todo su despreocupado mundo de niña rica está a punto de desaparecer.

programme.title: Mi amiga Eva
programme.desc: Eva es una mujer de 50 años que lo tiene todo, y a la vez no. Le falto algo. Un viaje de negocios a Roma y el vecino de la habitación contigua se lo recuerda: quiere volver a enamorarse antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: Los domingos
programme.desc: Ainara, una joven idealista de 17 años que tiene que decidir que carrera estudiar. O, al menos, eso espera su familia. Sin embargo, la joven se plantea abrazar la vida de monja de clausura. La noticia pilla por sorpresa a toda la familia.

programme.title: Amarga Navidad
programme.desc: Elsa, directora de publicidad, pierde a su madre durante el puente de diciembre. Incapaz de afrontar el duelo, se refugia obsesivamente en el trabajo hasta sufrir una crisis de ansiedad y huir a Lanzarote con una amiga que también necesita escapar.

programme.title: Así se hizo 'Cronos': los testimonios reales
programme.desc: Contenido exclusivo de la película 'Cronos', ya en cines. Los testimonios de los protagonistas reales del dispositivo activado tras al atentado terrorista de Las Ramblas.

programme.title: Calle Málaga
programme.desc: María Ángeles, una española de 79 años, vive sola en Tánger hasta que su hija llega desde Madrid con la intención de vender el piso familiar. Decidida a no desaparecer de su propia vida, se rebela para conservar su casa, sus recuerdos y su autonomía.

programme.title: La habitación de al lado
programme.desc: Ingrid, una novelista de autoficción, descubre en una firma de libros que su amiga Martha, reportera de guerra, padece una grave enfermedad. Muy amigas en su juventud, aunque separadas desde hace tiempo, la cercana muerte de Martha volverá a unirlas.

programme.title: Los amantes del Círculo Polar
programme.desc: El romance entre Otto y Ana empezó cuando ambos eran niños y compañeros de escuela. Años más tarde, durante la adolescencia, se convierten en hermanos al casarse la madre de Ana con el padre de Otto. Y tras algunos altos y bajos, deberán reunirse en el Círculo Polar Ártico.Tras ''Vacas'', ''La ardilla roja'' y ''Tierra'', el director vasco Julio Medem volvió a la carga con esta historia de amor en la que dispuso de más medios que en sus anteriores filmes. A pesar de este aumento en el presupuesto, ''Los amantes del Círculo Polar'' no deja de ser un ejemplo de lo que estas películas ya venían anunciando: la plasmación de un universo personal, sensual y onírico.Medem, inspirado por la simetría de su nombre, que se lee igual del derecho y del revés, creó esta historia cuyos protagonistas también tienen nombres palindrómicos. Esta simetría se traslada a la estructura de la película, ya que empieza y termina con las mismas imágenes.

programme.title: Mujeres al borde de un ataque de nervios
programme.desc: Iván y Pepa, una pareja de actores de doblaje, rompen su relación sin que él sepa que ella está embarazada. Pepa espera en vano noticias de Iván y, mientras tanto, trata de habituarse como puede a su nueva situación.

programme.title: El diputado
programme.desc: Roberto Orbea, militante de un partido de izquierdas durante la época franquista, es elegido diputado en las elecciones de 1.977. Cuando está a punto de ser nombrado Secretario General de su partido, un grupo de extrema derecha le prepara un chantaje aprovechándose de su homosexualidad, y preparándole un joven amante. Los planes del grupo derechista están a punto de fracasar cuando el diputado y el jovencito se enamoran. Ante estas circunstancias, los derechistas no tienen más opción que matar al amante y tratar de involucrar en el escándalo al diputado. Rodada poco después del momento que relata, la película supuso un gran revuelo. Eloy de la Iglesia (''La estanquera de Vallecas'') fue el responsable de dirigir esta transgresora cinta, con una fuerte carga de izquierdas, y que trataba un tema tabú para la época, el de la homosexualidad. Cuando el filme se estaba preparando, y ante la similitud con el caso de uno de los diputados de su partido, Enrique Tierno Galván, entonces Secretario General del Partido Socialista, fue a ver a Santiago Carrillo para que impidiera que el proyecto continuara adelante. Un ejemplo más de que muchas veces la realidad supera a la ficción.

programme.title: Landa
programme.desc: Alfredo Landa es, probablemente, uno de los actores más populares de la historia del cine español. Este documental lo retrata en toda su complejidad, mostrando todas sus aristas.

programme.title: Eloy de la Iglesia, adicto al cine
programme.desc: Nominado en los premios Goya y en los Forqué 2026. Retrata a uno de los directores más valientes y provocadores del cine español. Con sus películas desafió la censura y se atrevió a mostrar un mundo que pocos querían ver.

programme.title: El sur
programme.desc: Estrella vive en un pueblo del norte. La niña siente una gran fascinación por su padre, que se acrecienta al descubrir que hace mucho tiempo hubo otra mujer en su vida. Sin embargo, le será muy difícil averiguar más cosas sobre la historia con esa misteriosa mujer.Tuvieron que pasar diez años desde ''El espíritu de la colmena'' para que el director Víctor Erice volviera a ponerse detrás de una cámara. Su siguiente obra reflejó de nuevo el particular universo poético del cineasta, esta vez centrado en la relación entre un padre y una hija. Erice tuvo importantes diferencias creativas con los productores de la película, que le obligaron a recortar una buena parte del metraje y añadir una voz en off. Sin embargo, esto no impidió que ''El sur'' fuera considerada por los críticos como una de las mejores películas de la historia del cine español y que se convirtiera en la ganadora de varios premios internacionales. Otro de sus logros fue el descubrimiento de Icíar Bollaín, que empezó así una fructífera carrera como actriz y realizadora.

programme.title: Martín (Hache)
programme.desc: Martín, un director argentino de cine, culto, maduro e irritable, debe volver a Argentina porque su hijo ha sufrido un ataque producido por sobredosis de cocaína. El hijo, Hache, es un joven desorientado, sin referencia paterna, que decide acatar la decisión de su padre de ir a vivir a España con él. Allí conocerá el ambiente en el que se mueve este, así como a su pareja, Alicia, y a su amigo homosexual, Dante.Intenso drama intimista de Adolfo Aristarain (''Un lugar en el mundo'', ''La ley de la frontera''), con sugerentes diálogos basados en un guion estructurado para el lucimiento de los cuatro protagonistas. La historia trata los temas habituales en la filmografía del director argentino: incomunicación, soledad, desequilibrios sociales e intolerancia. La película le valió un Goya a Cecilia Roth como mejor actriz y la Concha de Plata al mejor actor a Federico Luppi. Ambos ya habían coincidido en 1992 bajo las órdenes de Aristarain en la alabada ''Un lugar en el mundo''.

programme.title: Manolito Gafotas
programme.desc: A Manolo García Moreno, de Carabanchel Alto, Madrid, todo el mundo lo conoce como Manolito Gafotas. Manolito espera con ilusión la llegada de su padre, camionero, ya que espera poder empezar a conocer el que será su medio de ganarse la vida en el futuro.

programme.title: Todo sobre mi madre
programme.desc: Manuela es una enfermera que sufre un terrible golpe: su hijo Esteban de 17 años, al que está muy unida, fallece en un accidente. Poco antes de morir, el muchacho había acabado de escribir las últimas líneas de un libro titulado ''Todo sobre mi madre'', en el que expresaba su inquietud por no haber conocido jamás a su padre.Una historia de mujeres, en la línea de los mejores dramas de George Cukor, que se convirtió en el mayor éxito a nivel internacional de Pedro Almodóvar hasta el momento de su estreno. Ganó, entre otros, el Óscar a la mejor película extranjera, el premio al mejor director del festival de Cannes, el Globo de Oro al mejor filme de habla no inglesa, el César (equivalente galo de los Goya) y el David de Donatello del festival de Venecia; amén de siete premios Goya de los 14 a los que fue candidata.

programme.title: La Celestina
programme.desc: El joven e impulsivo Calisto, aconsejado por su criado Sempronio, reclama los servicios de Celestina para conseguir ganar el corazón de la bella Melibea, a quien sus padres planean casar rápidamente y con el mejor partido.

programme.title: La flor de mi secreto
programme.desc: Leocadia Macías, famosa escritora de novela rosa, atraviesa una crisis no solo creativa, sino también familiar y matrimonial. Su marido, un militar, tiene una aventura con su mejor amiga, mientras que ella misma mantiene un curioso 'affaire' con un periodista. Encima, el hijo de su asistenta no duda en robarle para salir adelante en su afán de llegar a ser bailarín. Marisa Paredes fue candidata al Goya por esta comedia agridulce de Pedro Almodóvar, más dramática y sombría que la mayoría de sus anteriores trabajos. ''La flor de mi secreto'' guarda, además, similitudes con los clásicos dramas de los años 50, rodados por Jane Wyman y el director Douglas Sirk (''Solo el cielo lo sabe'', ''Obsesión''), que desprenden un cierto tono trágico muy similar al filme español (siempre guardando las distancias, ya que el universo del director manchego es muy personal). Almodóvar suele acertar siempre con el reparto de sus películas y esta no es la excepción. Particularmente divertidas son las escenas entre Rossy de Palma y Chus Lampreave.

programme.title: Los amantes del Círculo Polar
programme.desc: El romance entre Otto y Ana empezó cuando ambos eran niños y compañeros de escuela. Años más tarde, durante la adolescencia, se convierten en hermanos al casarse la madre de Ana con el padre de Otto. programme.title: La ardilla roja
programme.desc: En una noche de verano, Jota, desesperado por el abandono de su gran amor, intenta suicidarse arrojándose al mar. En ese momento ve caer en la arena de la playa a una chica que ha tenido un accidente de moto.

programme.title: Per bruixa i metzinera
programme.desc: Cebriana está segura de haber visto un fuego de noche en la montaña. No hay restos de brasas ni testigos que corroboren su visión.

programme.title: Becoming Elizabeth
programme.desc: Thomas Seymour wird des Hochverrats beschuldigt, weil er den jungen König entführen wollte. Auch Elizabeth gerät durch ihre Nähe zu ihm unter Verdacht, wird unter Hausarrest gestellt und von Lord Dudley verhört. programme.desc: Last season's runners-up Brisbane Heat face Tammy Beaumont and the Adelaide Strikers in the WBBL. The two teams met earlier this week, with Adelaide coming out on top. (29.11)

programme.title: WBBL 2025 Highlights
programme.desc: An all-Sydney WBBL contest between the Sixers and Thunder. The last time the two met earlier this month, Caoimhe Bray's hat-trick helped the Sixers on their way to victory. (29.11)

programme.title: WBBL 2025 Highlights
programme.desc: In the WBBL Challenger, a place in the final is up for grabs as the Knockout winners Perth Scorchers take on the Sixers in Sydney. Table toppers Hobart Hurricanes await the winner. (11.12)

programme.title: 5th Test England v India 2025
programme.desc: England and India get set for a grandstand finale to their five-match Test series. Thwarted by the fighting spirit of Shubman Gill's India at Old Trafford, the hosts still lead 2-1. (31.07)

programme.title: 5th Test England v India 2025
programme.desc: The second day of the final Test between England and India. In the absence of Ben Stokes, England - captained by Ollie Pope - reduced India to 204 for six on a rain-hit opening day. (01.08)

programme.title: 5th Test England v India 2025
programme.desc: An Indian fightback has the third day of the final Test at the Oval finely poised as the tourists - who are chasing a series-levelling win - return to the middle leading by 52. (02.08)

programme.title: 5th Test England v India 2025
programme.desc: Set a target of 374 by the tourists, England are 50 for one needing to complete their second-highest run chase in Test history to secure series victory over India at the Oval. (03.08)

programme.title: 5th Test England v India 2025
programme.desc: In a fitting finale to a thrilling series, England need 35 runs to claim a 3-1 win, while India go in search of four wickets for a 2-2 draw on the last day of the fifth Test. (04.08)

programme.title: WBBL 2025 Highlights
programme.desc: Table toppers Hobart Hurricanes go up against second-in-the-standings Melbourne again, looking to avenge Wednesday's defeat. The Stars are on a four-game winning run in the WBBL. (01.12)

programme.title: WBBL 2025 Highlights
programme.desc: A force to be reckoned with for much of the WBBL campaign, the Hurricanes have been dealt back-to-back defeats. Can Nat Sciver-Brunt and co respond here against Perth Scorchers? (29.11)

programme.title: WBBL
programme.desc: Melbourne Stars face Hobart Hurricanes in the WBBL.

programme.title: WBBL 2025 Highlights

programme.title: WBBL 2025 Highlights

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland - Donegal Town
programme.desc: In Donegal Town, Dermot's journey takes him further south along the Wild Atlantic Way, discovering a place where Irish tradition and global flavours sit side by side. His day begins at family-run Hannah Hats, where he's fitted in iconic Donegal tweed and learns why this rugged corner of Ireland became famous for its beautifully flecked fabric. Dressed fit for a fine meal, Dermot visits one of Ireland's most unexpected culinary hotspots: Chandpur, widely regarded as Ireland's best curry house. He meets Bangladeshi-born chef Rana, and together they cook railway curry using outstanding local Donegal lamb and potatoes - it's a heaven-made match of Asian flavours and quality Irish produce. For pudding, Dermot meets chef Brian McDermott, one of the biggest champions of Donegal's food scene. Together they bake a classic Irish apple pie, with Brian revealing why all the local rain creates richer grass, creamier milk and extra buttery pastry, making Donegal Town a dessert destination. - 2024

programme.title: James May's Toy Stories - Hornby
programme.desc: James attempts to build the longest ever model railway track - a whopping ten miles long. He builds it in Devon, linking two towns, Barnstaple and Bideford, which last had a train service over forty years ago. Thousands of people turn out to help, but nature and the odds look to be against the plucky little engine in what is certainly James's most ambitious idea yet. (Documentary, Reality) - 2009

programme.title: David Jason's Secret Service
programme.desc: Passionate espionage enthusiast Sir David Jason searches for the origins of the British Secret Service and discovers the legendary characters, audacious missions and makeshift methods that characterised the early days of spying. (Documentary, Crime, History) - 2017

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys - Northern Ireland and Ireland Part 5
programme.desc: Michael heads to Sandycove, a popular spot for swimmers year-round, and because it was featured in James Joyce's celebrated novel 'Ulysses'. (Documentary, Travel)

programme.title: World at War - Alone
programme.desc: With France fallen, the USA as yet uninvolved and the Russian pact with Hitler still in force, Britain stands all alone against the Germans forces across the English Channel. (Documentary, War, History)

programme.title: World at War - Barbarossa
programme.desc: Hitler turns his tanks towards Russia. After a succession of devastating victories, the Germans delay fatally, and the fierce Russian winter takes a grip. (Documentary, War, History)

programme.title: World at War - Banzai
programme.desc: The Japanese, at war on the Chinese mainland since 1931, hope for quick victories over the British and the Dutch, but 7 December 1941 brings the infamous attack on Pearl Harbor, and the start of an all-conquering sweep through Southeast Asia culminating in the taking of Singapore. (Documentary, War, History)

programme.title: World at War - On Our Way
programme.desc: America entered conflict after the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor, but the conflict in Europe and the conflict in the Pacific were two separate wars. Many Americans would have been content to forget about Hitler and Europe. Despite opposition from congress President Roosevelt, however, was committed to fighting Hitler. Eventually Hitler declared war on America, thus relieving Roosevelt of a difficult decision. (Documentary, War, History)

programme.title: River Walks - Series 1 : River Tees

programme.title: Wild Japan - The Southwest Islands
programme.desc: In the far south of Japan, there is a chain of islands stretching towards the tropics - a place where all life is influenced by the power of the sea, and where volcanoes and typhoons are forces to be reckoned with. (Documentary, Animals, Miniseries, Nature) - 2015

programme.title: Wild Japan - Hokkaido
programme.desc: This episode looks at Hokkaido, Japan's northernmost - and wildest - island, a place totally unlike the rest of the country. Every year it swings from a bitter Siberian winter into the warmth of a Mediterranean-like summer. (Documentary, Animals, Miniseries, Nature) - 2015

programme.title: Wild West: America's Great Frontier - Desert Heartlands
programme.desc: This legendary land of red rocks and vast canyons, outlaws and gunslingers, is a brutally tough place to live. But nature has found some extraordinary ways to win through, forging a pioneering spirit found nowhere else on Earth. Discover the amazing ways that mustangs and coyotes, Hopi farmers and even desert tortoises have found to survive in this extremely testing land. (Documentary, Animals, Nature) - 2016

programme.title: Wild West: America's Great Frontier - The High Country
programme.desc: America's High Country is the land of grizzly bears and giant trees, of frigid winters and scorching summers, of tough ranchers and gold-rush fever. From the Rockies to the Sierra Nevada, survival demands endurance and know-how. From parasitic plants to thieving black bears, tenacious pikas and battling bison, it's in the High Country that the west gets really wild. (Documentary, Animals, Nature) - 2016

programme.title: 40 Hits of 1986 at the BBC
programme.desc: Forty classic hits from 1986 taken from the BBC's archives, including George Michael, Simply Red, A-ha, Samantha Fox, Pet Shop Boys and Eurythmics.

programme.title: TOTP 1986: Big Hits
programme.desc: Top of the Pops Big Hits is back with a bang for the year of 1986. Pop, new wave, rock, funk and R&B are all celebrated in this 60-minute special.

programme.title: Top of the Pops: The Story of 1986
programme.desc: Paul Heaton, Mick Hucknall, Sinitta, The Communards and Swing Out Sister are among the acts steering us through the changes that impacted Britain and the music industry in 1986.

programme.title: Saving Lives at Sea
programme.desc: 7/10. The St Helier crew must rescue a yacht before it drifts onto a notoriously dangerous reef. [S,AD,SL]

programme.title: Finding Britain's Slave Traders with David Olusoga
programme.desc: 2/2. David Olusoga reveals how thousands more British people became slave traders. [S,AD,SL]

programme.title: This is BBC Two
programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: World Track Cycling Championships 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage of the morning session on the final day of the Track Cycling World Championships in Shanghai, featuring the women's keirin and men's sprint.

programme.title: This is BBC Two
programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: 18/26. Dougie is in the Borders to round up all the action from the Sheep Dog World Trial at Lauder. Rosie is on Bute for a trialling masterclass from one of the country's best handlers.

programme.title: World Track Cycling Championships 2026
programme.desc: Clare Balding presents live coverage of the final day in Shanghai.

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
programme.desc: Matt Tebbutt serves up delicious recipes from Angela Hartnett, Ollie Dabbous and Rachel Allen. Meanwhile, Rick Stein and the Hairy Bikers head out of the studio.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: 3/8. Eva enjoys Bordeaux's world-famous wines with some surprising pairings, while also sampling its fresh caviar, beef and duck served with masterful bordelaise sauces. [S,AD]

programme.title: The Colditz Story
programme.desc: Based on the true story from World War II of the notorious German POW establishment and the officers who tried to escape from it. [1954]

programme.title: MOTD Live: Women's Super...
programme.desc: ...League: Manchester City v Brighton. Manchester City play Brighton & Hove Albion in the Women's Super League.

programme.title: This Farming Life
programme.desc: 7/12. Rachel and Camy prepare to welcome the Park Cheviot lambs. Nikki and Ollie's rabbit-breeding programme bears fruit. Robert heads to market to sell previous year's calves.

programme.title: The Book That Changed My Life
programme.desc: Five surprising and inspiring stories of how books can change lives, led by Her Majesty Queen Camilla. [S,AD]

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Antiques series. Paul Martin presents from Wrest Park, a 19th-century French-style chateau, and is joined by antiques experts Anita Manning and Christina Trevanion.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: 4/8. Eva and her Breton guide Tanguy Thomassin explore the vast oyster beds of Cancale, oyster capital of Brittany. [S,AD]

programme.title: The Balkans: Europe's Forgotten Frontier
programme.desc: 1/2. The BBC's Europe editor Katya Adler travels to Croatia, Bosnia and Albania. [S,AD]

programme.title: Wilderness with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: 4/4. Simon Reeve embarks on a 3,000-mile journey across the deserts, plains and mountains of Mongolia in search of snow leopards and the nomadic people who hunt with golden eagles. [S,AD]

programme.title: Later... with Jools Holland
programme.desc: 2/6. With Royal Blood, Moses Boyd, Shygirl, Kingfishr, Ayanna Witter-Johnson and Tony Iommi. Contains some strong language.

programme.title: Priscilla
programme.desc: Fourteen-year-old schoolgirl Priscilla Beaulieu is gradually drawn into a strange and unhealthy codependent life with Elvis Presley. Contains some strong language. [2023] [S,AD]

programme.title: Question Time
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce presents an hour of debate from Brecon. On the panel are Stephen Kinnock, Mims Davies, Delyth Jewell, James Evans and George Monbiot. [S,SL]

programme.title: Not Going Out
programme.desc: 4/6. Lee and Lucy invite two women from the local church into their home to referee an argument they are having about money. [S,AD,SL]

programme.title: This is BBC Two
programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: The teams are spoilt for choice as they hunt for bargains among the stalls in West Sussex alongside experts Caroline Hawley and Thomas Forrester. [S,AD]

programme.title: The Great House Revival
programme.desc: 3/4. Paul buys back his former family home, but can he save it from rot and ruin? [S,SL]

programme.title: Match of the Day
programme.desc: Highlights from four Premier League matches, including Nottingham Forest against Arsenal and Leeds United's clash with Manchester United at Elland Road.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: Twenty-four hours a day, the latest national and international stories as they break.

programme.title: Politics Live
programme.desc: The big political issues of the day.

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: 11/20. Game show presented by Rick Edwards in which players score points by answering questions correctly while avoiding the Impossible answers.

programme.title: The Answer Run
programme.desc: 6/25. Comedian Jason Manford hosts an exciting, fast-paced quiz show, where three couples face a series of 50/50 questions which hurtle The Answer Run down towards them.

programme.title: The Boss
programme.desc: 15/20. Susan Calman hosts the quiz show of tactics, knowledge and nerve. Contestants must work as a team, but ultimately there can only be one Boss. Who will walk away with the money?

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: 11/20. Michael Portillo re-enacts the Battle of Shrewsbury, explores the town's beautiful Gothic cathedral and rides the Telford Steam Railway's flagship locomotive. [S,AD]

programme.title: The Great House Revival
programme.desc: 4/8. With rising costs and multiple setbacks, will artist Cora be able to realise her dream of creating her own home and studio within this old town house?

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: 8/26. A visit to Hampton Court brings more fascinating finds for Michael Aspel and the team of experts. Among the items on show are a coral bracelet and a dress by Vivienne Westwood.

programme.title: Flog It!

programme.title: The Conjuring
programme.desc: In 1970, paranormal investigators and demonologists Lorraine (Vera Farmiga) and Ed (Patrick Wilson) Warren are summoned to the home of Carolyn (Lili Taylor) and Roger (Ron Livingston) Perron. The Perrons and their five daughters have recently moved into a secluded farmhouse, where a supernatural presence has made itself known. Though the manifestations are relatively benign at first, events soon escalate in horrifying fashion, especially after the Warrens discover the house's macabre history. (Horror, Thriller) - 2013

programme.title: Final Destination
programme.desc: Alex Browning is embarking on a trip to Paris. He experiences a premonition -- he sees the plane explode moments after leaving the ground. Insisting that everyone get off the plane, Alex and seven other people are forced to disembark. All watch as the plane actually explodes in a fireball. He and the other survivors have briefly cheated death, but will not be able to evade their fate for very long. One by one, these fugitives from fate fall victim to the grim reaper. (Horror, Thriller) - 2000

programme.title: Final Destination 2
programme.desc: Kimberly (A.J. Cook) has a premonition of a horrible highway accident killing multiple people -- including her and her friends. She blocks the cars behind her on the ramp from joining traffic -- and as a police trooper (Michael Landes) arrives, the accident actually happens. Now, Death is stalking this group of mistaken survivors -- and one by one they are dying as they were supposed to on the highway. (Horror, Thriller) - 2003

programme.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
programme.desc: A year after running over a fisherman and dumping his body in the water, four friends reconvene when Julie (Jennifer Love Hewitt) receives a frightening letter telling her that their crime was seen. While pursuing who he thinks is responsible for the letter, Barry (Ryan Phillippe) is run over by a man with a meat hook. The bloodletting only increases from there, as the killer with the hook continues to stalk Julie, Helen (Sarah Michelle Gellar) and Ray (Freddie Prinze Jr.). (Horror, Thriller) - 1997

programme.title: The Final Destination
programme.desc: While enjoying a day at the track, Nick O'Bannon (Bobby Campo) has a horrific premonition of his friends and him all dying in a freak accident involving many racecars. Mere seconds before the vision comes true, he manages to convince them to leave. Although they cheat death then, the survivors each begin to meet a grisly end, and Nick tries to figure a way to escape a similar fate. (Horror, Thriller) - 2009

programme.title: The Mist
programme.desc: After a powerful storm damages their Maine home, David Drayton (Thomas Jane) and his young son head into town to gather food and supplies. Soon afterward, a thick fog rolls in and engulfs the town, trapping the Draytons and others in the grocery store. Terror mounts as deadly creatures reveal themselves outside, but that may be nothing compared to the threat within, where a zealot (Marcia Gay Harden) calls for a sacrifice. (Horror, Science fiction, Thriller) - 2007

programme.title: Friday the 13th - Part III
programme.desc: The third installment in the "Friday the 13th" series picks up on the day after the carnage with homicidal maniac Jason Voorhees (Richard Brooker) stealing some clothes and killing a local store owner. Meanwhile, Chris (Dana Kimmell) and her sometimes boyfriend, Rick (Paul Kratka), are hosting a group of teenage friends at Chris' lake house. Despite a run-in with a local biker gang, they enjoy an amiable weekend together -- that is, until Jason begins knocking off kids and bikers alike. (Horror, Action, Crime drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 1982

programme.title: Friday the 13th
programme.desc: Crystal Lake's history of murder doesn't deter counselors from setting up a summer camp in the woodsy area. Superstitious locals warn against it, but the fresh-faced young people -- Jack (Kevin Bacon), Alice (Adrienne King), Bill (Harry Crosby), Marcie (Jeannine Taylor) and Ned (Mark Nelson) -- pay little heed to the old-timers. Then they find themselves stalked by a brutal killer. As they're slashed, shot and stabbed, the counselors struggle to stay alive against a merciless opponent. (Horror) - 1980

programme.title: Friday the 13th, Part 2
programme.desc: The second entry in the long-running horror series focuses on a group of teenage would-be counselors converging on Camp Crystal Lake for training under the tutelage of head counselor Paul (John Furey). Inevitably, Paul relates the story of Jason Voorhees (Warrington Gillette), a boy who ostensibly drowned at the camp and whose mother murdered a group of counselors in revenge. No one takes the tale seriously until a very much alive Jason begins gruesomely eliminating people. (Horror, Action, Mystery, Crime drama, Thriller) - 1981

programme.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors
programme.desc: During a hallucinatory incident, young Kristen Parker (Patricia Arquette) has her wrists slashed by dream-stalking monster Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund). Her mother, mistaking the wounds for a suicide attempt, sends Kristen to a psychiatric ward, where she joins a group of similarly troubled teens. One of the doctors there is Nancy Thompson (Heather Langenkamp), who had battled Freddy some years before. Nancy senses a potential in Kristen to rid the world of Freddy once and for all. (Horror) - 1987

programme.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 2: Freddy's Revenge
programme.desc: Jesse Walsh (Mark Patton) moves with his family into the home of the lone survivor from a series of attacks by dream-stalking monster Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund). There, Jesse is bedeviled by nightmares and inexplicably violent impulses. It turns out Freddy needs a host body to carry out his gruesome vendetta against the youth of Springwood, Ohio. While Freddy gains influence, Jesse and his girlfriend, Lisa (Kim Myers), race against the clock trying to figure out what's going on. (Horror) - 1985

programme.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
programme.desc: In Wes Craven's classic slasher film, several Midwestern teenagers fall prey to Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund), a disfigured midnight mangler who preys on the teenagers in their dreams -- which, in turn, kills them in reality. After investigating the phenomenon, Nancy (Heather Langenkamp) begins to suspect that a dark secret kept by her and her friends' parents may be the key to unraveling the mystery, but can Nancy and her boyfriend Glen (Johnny Depp) solve the puzzle before it's too late? (Horror, Thriller) - 1984

programme.title: Freddy vs. Jason
programme.desc: Two horror icons face off in this supernatural movie. Disfigured serial killer Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund), who attacks his victims in their dreams, has lost much of his power since citizens of his town have become less afraid of him. Enlisting the help of fellow violent murderer Jason Voorhees (Ken Kirzinger), Freddy orchestrates a new killing spree. However, when the hockey-mask-wearing psychopath won't stop chopping up Freddy's intended victims, the two ghouls start to battle each other. (Horror) - 2003

programme.title: Hocus Pocus
programme.desc: After moving to Salem, Mass., teenager Max Dennison (Omri Katz) explores an abandoned house with his sister Dani (Thora Birch) and their new friend, Allison (Vinessa Shaw). However, Morticia (Anjelica Huston) begins to suspect the man is a fraud, since he cannot recall details of Fester's life. With the help of lawyer Tully Alford (Dan Hedaya), Fester manages to get the Addams clan evicted from their home. programme.title: MLB Central ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown." (Baseball) - 2015-04-06

programme.title: MLB Now ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls. (Baseball) - 2013-04-01

programme.title: Intentional Talk ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media. (Baseball) - 2011-07-13

programme.title: Minute to Win It
programme.desc: As a speed skater, Apolo Anton Ohno won a gold medal at the 2006 Winter Olympics for finishing a race within 42 seconds. The contestants on this game show hosted by Ohno have 18 seconds longer than that to complete each task in order to win a quarter of a million dollars as the grand prize. Contestants compete in as many as 10 challenges of increasing difficulty, each with a one-minute time limit, and which utilize everyday household items. Throughout the game contestants have the chance to walk away with any money earned to that point but risk losing the cash if they fail to complete a challenge within the time limit. A competitor who goes all the way and completes all 10 challenges in time, receives the $250,000. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20130625

programme.title: America Says
programme.desc: Game show series have been making a comeback in television, and media and "America Says" is no exception. This program is following in the footsteps of the popular mobile app game "HQ Trivia." The network is planning its own spin on the game show, and Fran Shea, evp, programming and marketing, says she "has been studying the GSN audience and prepared a slate of new shows that reflect what it wants: family-friendly, fun, escapist television." programme.title: Idiotest
programme.desc: If you buy into the title of this game show, you might be an idiot if you can't answer the questions asked of contestants. Each episode features two pairs of competitors, sometimes from a particular rivalry -- for example, UCLA vs. USC or Trekkies vs."Star Wars" fans -- participating in several rounds of simple, rapid-fire questions testing people's observational skills, attention to detail, and general knowledge. The winning pair takes home the money earned in the game and plays the bonus round, where even more cash is up for grabs. Comic Ben Gleib hosts the show that isn't afraid to call its players idiots. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20140812

programme.title: Baggage
programme.desc: Contestants on this dating game show don't want to hear the elimination line "I'm sorry, but you have too much baggage." How much is acceptable among three contestants in each episode is determined by the "dater," who hears the candidates' intimate secrets and hidden flaws, as well as their attempts to deflect these traits by describing their positive attributes. After two elimination rounds leave one remaining contestant, it's the dater's turn to reveal his or her own baggage ... and then the contestant decides to go forward with the date or not. Jerry Springer hosts. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20100419

programme.title: Mind of a Man
programme.desc: Women have been trying to answer the question of "what do men think" for years. "Mind of a Man" tries to help them figure out what is on the mind of the average guy. Each half-hour episode pits two female contestants against each other as they try to correctly answer questions asked of 100 men. Helping the women along the way is a rotating celebrity panel composed of a mix of men and women who offer opinions. The contestant who is more successful in understanding the mind of a man wins the game and advances to the bonus round, in which she can amass up to $10,000. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20140108

programme.title: Divided
programme.desc: Veteran game show host and producer Mike Richards emcees this show that is described as "part game show, part social experiment." Four strangers must work as a team on each episode, coming to an agreement on the answer to each question Richards asks. They have to do it quickly, though, because as the clock ticks down so does the amount of money the contestants can win. So the longer they debate, the less a correct answer earns them. As the amount of money available increases in each round, the intensity ramps up as there is a point when the team must collectively decide on one member to eliminate. At the end of the game, whatever money has been won to that point is divided into three highly uneven amounts and the three remaining players have to decide who gets which portion of the cash. They find themselves on the clock again as they attempt to come to a consensus on that decision. If the time runs out before settling on a solution, they lose everything. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20161125

They have to do it quickly, though, because as the clock ticks down so does the amount of money the contestants can win. So the longer they debate, the less a correct answer earns them. As the amount of money available increases in each round, the intensity ramps up as there is a point when the team must collectively decide on one member to eliminate. At the end of the game, whatever money has been won to that point is divided into three highly uneven amounts and the three remaining players have to decide who gets which portion of the cash. They find themselves on the clock again as they attempt to come to a consensus on that decision. If the time runs out before settling on a solution, they lose everything. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20161125

programme.title: Emogenius
programme.desc: Emojis can be polarizing, with some people constantly using the little drawings and others not caring for them. Love 'em or hate 'em, emojis can be worth money on this comedic game show. Each half-hour episode pits two pairs of contestants against each other in a battle to see which team knows emojis better. The first challenge forces the contestants to decipher a series of pop culture-inspired emoji messages. In the second round, the contestants must send each other strings of emojis that their partners must correctly guess. The winning team then advances to the bonus round, in which the teammates trade off sending and guessing rapid-fire emoji messages. If they beat the bonus round, they take home $10,000. Social media star Hunter March hosts the show, and he has game show hosting in his blood -- grandfather Hal March served as emcee on "The $64,000 Question" in the 1950s. (Show, Series, Game show, Comedy) - 20170607

programme.title: Minute to Win It
programme.desc: As a speed skater, Apolo Anton Ohno won a gold medal at the 2006 Winter Olympics for finishing a race within 42 seconds. The contestants on this game show hosted by Ohno have 18 seconds longer than that to complete each task in order to win a quarter of a million dollars as the grand prize. Contestants compete in as many as 10 challenges of increasing difficulty, each with a one-minute time limit, and which utilize everyday household items. Throughout the game contestants have the chance to walk away with any money earned to that point but risk losing the cash if they fail to complete a challenge within the time limit. A competitor who goes all the way and completes all 10 challenges in time, receives the $250,000. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20130625

programme.title: America Says
programme.desc: Game show series have been making a comeback in television, and media and "America Says" is no exception. This program is following in the footsteps of the popular mobile app game "HQ Trivia." The network is planning its own spin on the game show, and Fran Shea, evp, programming and marketing, says she "has been studying the GSN audience and prepared a slate of new shows that reflect what it wants: family-friendly, fun, escapist television." programme.title: Baggage
programme.desc: Contestants on this dating game show don't want to hear the elimination line "I'm sorry, but you have too much baggage." How much is acceptable among three contestants in each episode is determined by the "dater," who hears the candidates' intimate secrets and hidden flaws, as well as their attempts to deflect these traits by describing their positive attributes. After two elimination rounds leave one remaining contestant, it's the dater's turn to reveal his or her own baggage ... and then the contestant decides to go forward with the date or not. Jerry Springer hosts. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20100419

Now originating from one of the SEC Network studios in Charlotte, N.C., the show is a forum for lively discussion and debate of all things SEC and across the spectrum of college sports, with Finebaum playing the role of both moderator and provocateur. programme.title: The Paul Finebaum Show ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
programme.desc: Veteran writer, reporter and radio personality Paul Finebaum built a legion of loyal sports fans as the "Voice of the SEC" during 20 years hosting his Birmingham, Ala.-based radio talk show. When ESPN launched the SEC Network in 2014, it was only natural that Finebaum became its first on-air hire, bringing his radio show -- and those passionate followers -- with him. Now originating from one of the SEC Network studios in Charlotte, N.C., the show is a forum for lively discussion and debate of all things SEC and across the spectrum of college sports, with Finebaum playing the role of both moderator and provocateur. The show airs weekday afternoons throughout the year on SEC Network. (Sports talk, Interview) - 2013-12-02

programme.desc: When Las Vegas Police respond to a self-defense shooting, the case appears open and shut; following the discovery of bombshell video evidence that contradicts the shooter's initial story, a mother's desperation for him. (Documentary)

programme.title: Dateline: Unforgettable - The Music Box
programme.desc: After Lisa Zeigert is killed, her family keeps the case in the public eye for decades; Andrea Canning reflects on the harrowing mystery and discusses the inspiration she's drawn from Lisa's loved ones. (News Magazine)

programme.title: Dateline: Unforgettable - Detective Story
programme.desc: A woman in Los Angeles is killed in an apparent botched burglary; nearly 20 years later, a detective discovers a clue that turns the case on its head; Josh Mankiewicz revisits a story with a twist that surprised him. (News Magazine)

programme.title: Dateline - The Woman Who Couldn't Scream - Part 1

programme.title: Dateline - The Woman Who Couldn't Scream - Part 2
programme.desc: When two women call 911 after hearing someone break into their apartment, their call for help holds the key to solving the mysterious murder of a young graduate student named Katie Sepich. (News Magazine, Documentary)

programme.title: Dateline - Hinckley: Diary of a Dangerous Mind

programme.title: A Plan to Kill - Killer Competition

programme.title: A Plan to Kill - Deadly Desire

programme.title: A Plan to Kill - Payment Plan

programme.title: A Plan to Kill - Digital Justice

programme.title: Killer Couples - Kemia Hassel and Jeremy Cuellar

programme.title: Killer Couples - Patricia Teeter & Steven Brown

programme.title: Killer Couples - Patrick Frazee and Krystal Kenney

programme.title: Killer Couples - Jordan Hodge and Kenny Carlisle

programme.title: Killer Couples - Antoinette Martinez and Cameo Clines

programme.title: Killer Couples - Teresa Lewis and Matthew Shallenberger

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When a man (Christopher Lloyd) claiming to be Fester, the missing brother of Gomez Addams (Raul Julia), arrives at the Addams' home, the family is thrilled. However, Morticia (Anjelica Huston) begins to suspect the man is a fraud, since he cannot recall details of Fester's life. With the help of lawyer Tully Alford (Dan Hedaya), Fester manages to get the Addams clan evicted from their home. Gomez realizes the two men are conspiring to swindle the Addams fortune and that he must challenge Fester. (Fantasy, Dark comedy) - 1991

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: The members of the odd Addams Family are up to more macabre antics in this sequel. This time around, Gomez Addams (Raul Julia) and his wife, Morticia (Anjelica Huston), are celebrating the arrival of a baby boy. But siblings Wednesday (Christina Ricci) and Pugsley (Jimmy Workman) are none too happy about the new addition, and try their best to eliminate the infant. When nanny Debbie Jellinsky (Joan Cusack) appears to keep the kids in line, her presence leads to an unexpected treacherous twist. (Dark comedy, Fantasy) - 1993

programme.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: Four high school kids discover an old video game console and are drawn into the game's jungle setting, literally becoming the adult avatars they chose. What they discover is that you don't just play Jumanji - you must survive it. To beat the game and return to the real world, they'll have to go on the most dangerous adventure of their lives, discover what Alan Parrish left 20 years ago, and change the way they think about themselves - or they'll be stuck in the game forever. (Adventure, Action, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2017

programme.title: Children of the Corn
programme.desc: As physician Burt Stanton (Peter Horton) and his girlfriend, Vicky (Linda Hamilton), drive across the Midwest to his new job, their trip comes to a sudden halt when they encounter the body of a murdered boy in the road. In trying to contact the authorities, Burt and Vicky wander into a small town populated only by children, followers of sinister young preacher Isaac Chroner (John Franklin). Soon the couple is fleeing the youthful fanatics, who want to sacrifice them to their demonic deity. (Horror, Thriller) - 1984

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Doctor Louis Creed (Dale Midkiff) moves his family to Maine, where he meets a friendly local named Jud Crandall (Fred Gwynne). After the Creeds' cat is accidentally killed, Crandall advises Louis to bury it in the ground near the old pet cemetery. The cat returns to life, its personality changed for the worse. When Louis' son, Gage (Miko Hughes), dies tragically, Louis decides to bury the boy's body in the same ground despite the warnings of Crandall and Louis' visions of a deceased patient. (Horror, Thriller) - 1989

programme.title: Cujo
programme.desc: In this tale of a killer canine, man's best friend turns into his worst enemy. When sweet St. Bernard Cujo is bitten by a bat, he starts behaving oddly and becomes very aggressive. As Cujo morphs into a dangerous beast, he goes on a rampage in a small town. Stay-at-home mom Donna (Dee Wallace) gets caught in Cujo's crosshairs on a fateful errand with her son, Tad (Danny Pintauro). Stuck in their tiny car, Donna and Tad have a frightening showdown with the crazed animal. (Horror, Thriller) - 1983

programme.title: Silver Bullet
programme.desc: When a series of unexplained murders occurs in the normally quiet town of Tarker's Mill, the residents decide to hunt down the killer. However, many of these vigilantes end up dead, and those who don't are any closer to finding an assailant. But, when a young wheelchair-using boy named Marty encounters a werewolf one night, the pieces begin to come together. Along with his sister and Uncle Red, Marty begins a mission to capture the werewolf once and for all. (Horror) - 1985

programme.title: Pet Sematary Two
programme.desc: When his mother, Renee (Darlanne Fluegel), dies, young Jeff Matthews (Edward Furlong) moves back to his hometown with his father, Chase (Anthony Edwards). Jeff grows friendly with Drew Gilbert (Jason McGuire) at school, who tells him about the Indian burial grounds that bring people and animals back to life, which led to the deaths of the Creed family who used to live in town. Desperately missing his mom, Jeff ignores warnings and buries her corpse, only to have her return in deadly zombie form. (Horror) - 1992

programme.title: An American Werewolf in London
programme.desc: David (David Naughton) and Jack (Griffin Dunne), two American college students, are backpacking through Britain when a large wolf attacks them. David survives with a bite, but Jack is brutally killed. As David heals in the hospital, he's plagued by violent nightmares of his mutilated friend, who warns David that he is becoming a werewolf. When David discovers the horrible truth, he contemplates committing suicide before the next full moon causes him to transform from man to murderous beast. (Horror, Comedy) - 1981

programme.title: Real Genius
programme.desc: When science whiz Mitch Taylor (Gabe Jarret) arrives at Pacific Tech as a freshman, he's paired up with genius senior Chris Knight (Val Kilmer) to work on a laser project. Mitch initially doesn't care for Knight's slacker attitude, but is eventually won over, and their friendship allows them to make new progress on the laser project. It's only when the boys learn that the government intends to use the laser as a weapon that they start to question what they've actually been working for. (Comedy) - 1985

programme.title: Adventures in Babysitting
programme.desc: When plans with her boyfriend fall through, high school senior Chris Parker (Elisabeth Shue) ends up babysitting the Anderson kids, Brad (Keith Coogan) and Sara (Maia Brewton). What should be a quiet night in, however, turns into a series of ridiculous exploits, starting when they leave the house to pick up Chris' friend Brenda (Penelope Ann Miller). Soon, Brad's buddy Daryl (Anthony Rapp) is involved, and the group must contend with car thieves, blues musicians and much more. (Comedy) - 1987

programme.title: Stand by Me
programme.desc: After learning that a stranger has been accidentally killed near their rural homes, four Oregon boys decide to go see the body. On the way, Gordie Lachance (Wil Wheaton), Vern Tessio (Jerry O'Connell), Chris Chambers (River Phoenix) and Teddy Duchamp (Corey Feldman) encounter a mean junk man and a marsh full of leeches, as they also learn more about one another and their very different home lives. Just a lark at first, the boys' adventure evolves into a defining event in their lives. (Comedy drama) - 1986

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: Moving in from Chicago, newcomer Ren McCormack (Kevin Bacon) is in shock when he discovers the small Midwestern town he now calls home has made dancing and rock music illegal. As he struggles to fit in, Ren faces an uphill battle to change things. With the help of his new friend, Willard Hewitt (Christopher Penn), and defiant teen Ariel Moore (Lori Singer), he might loosen up this conservative town. But Ariel's influential father, Reverend Shaw Moore (John Lithgow), stands in the way. (Drama, Music, Romance, Comedy) - 1984

programme.title: Trading Places
programme.desc: Upper-crust executive Louis Winthorpe III (Dan Aykroyd) and down-and-out hustler Billy Ray Valentine (Eddie Murphy) are the subjects of a bet by successful brokers Mortimer (Don Ameche) and Randolph Duke (Ralph Bellamy). An employee of the Dukes, Winthorpe is framed by the brothers for a crime he didn't commit, with the siblings then installing the street-smart Valentine in his position. When Winthorpe and Valentine uncover the scheme, they set out to turn the tables on the Dukes. (Comedy) - 1983
